# ¡Pinche Poutine! Digital

> A personal blog — articles, a reader mailing list, and contact. Posts live at /blog/<slug>.

## Read

- [Home](https://pinchepoutine.digital/): Latest posts and site intro.
- [Blog](https://pinchepoutine.digital/blog): Full post archive; individual posts are served at /blog/<slug>.
- [Contact](https://pinchepoutine.digital/contact): Get in touch.

## Notes for AI agents

- Post URLs are stable slugs under /blog/. The site supports reader language selection for date formatting.
- Subscribe/unsubscribe flows are transactional pages (confirmation, resend) and not content.
